_source: CBP ruling N286714 (2017): seven-layer blanks of five poplar plies with MDF outer plies, laminated in China and worked in Canada into a panel that is not surface covered; the 102.20 rule for heading 4412 was not met: CBP held China. The Canadian working is described here as profiling and finishing. In the D580 selection pool (Part 102, dated before 2024, in no development or held-out split) and excluded. Target by the D171 rule; plant capabilities at the target are an assumption.

product.name: Poplar plywood panel with MDF overlays
product.description: A seven-layer panel: five poplar plies at angles to each other between two thin MDF outer plies.

work the blanks into finished panels
